# satgat

satgat is a Korean AI document generator. Korean name 삿갓. Turns natural-language briefs into structured Korean documents on baekjaji canvas with ink typography, single dancheong accent (≤ 5%/page), Korean serif hierarchy, and print/PDF-aware layouts. 14 document templates.

Repository: https://github.com/unclejobs-ai/satgat
License: MIT
Live: https://satgat.vercel.app

Primary audience:
- Korean users writing documents for hiring, proposals, company profiles, newsletters, invitations, portfolios, product brochures, brand pages, and investor decks.
- AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) needing Korean document design constraints.

Install (any AI agent):
- npx satgat skill ~/.claude/skills/satgat   # AI agent skill
- npx satgat init my-satgat                  # full Next.js workspace
- git clone https://github.com/unclejobs-ai/satgat && npm install

Invoke via natural language:
- "이력서 한 장 만들어 주세요. 7년차 프론트엔드, 카카오·무신사·29CM."
- "신년 연하장 — 박상세 가족, 단정한 톤으로."
- "스타트업 IR 덱 한 벌, 시드 단계, 단청 강조."

Core workflow:
1. User selects one of 14 templates and writes a Korean natural-language brief of up to 1,200 characters.
2. The generator fills type-aware JSON slots and validates the resulting document.
3. The browser stores a private draft in sessionStorage and opens the React preview through an opaque UUID.
4. The same renderer serves screen preview, explicit content-bearing share links, browser print, specimen capture, and server PDF.

Important paths:
- bin/satgat.mjs: npx CLI entry (init / skill / dev / build / start).
- skills/satgat/SKILL.md: single-file design brief for AI agents.
- README.md: project overview, install paths, demo gallery, design rules.
- app/[lang]/page.tsx: React product landing at `/ko`.
- app/[lang]/examples/page.tsx: canonical runtime specimen catalog at `/ko/examples`.
- public/satgat/assets/examples/ko/: 14 canonical PNG/PDF pairs plus `manifest.json`.
- scripts/render-template-specimens.mjs: captures the runtime preview route into deterministic artifacts.
- scripts/verify-template-catalog.mjs: contract verification (definitions × registry × renderers × fixtures).
- scripts/template-preview-fixtures.mjs: realistic slot payloads for all 14 runtime templates.
- src/lib/templates/: runtime template definitions and registry.
- src/lib/design-system/constraint.ts: tokens (palette, fonts, ink bleed shadows).
- src/lib/bridge/prompt-builder.ts: type-aware AI generation contract.
- src/lib/generation/document-generator.ts: normalizes and validates AI-generated slot data.
- src/lib/engine/slot-list.ts + slot-image.ts: shape-tolerant slot normalizers.
- references/: Korean writing, design, anti-pattern, resume guides.

Runtime template catalog (14):
- resume, self-intro, business-card, brand-onepager, product-brochure, company-profile, investor-deck, brand-storybook, invitation, new-year-card, proposal, newsletter, portfolio, report.

Korean runtime specimen pack:
- One PNG and one PDF for every canonical template ID, in `TEMPLATE_IDS` order.
- `manifest.json` records the canonical ID, runtime metadata, dimensions, and PDF page count.
- Artifacts are generated from the private draft preview route, not a parallel static HTML renderer.

Design rules (8조):
1. Canvas: baekjaji #F7F7F2. No pure white. No warm parchment.
2. Single accent: dancheong #9B1B1B, ≤ 5%/page.
3. Secondary accent: jade #2E6B5E or gold #B8954F. Not both with dancheong.
4. All grays warm baekjaji-toned. No cool blue-gray.
5. Display 800, heading 700 myeongjo; body and labels use real 400 faces. Hierarchy by size and spacing.
6. Solid hex tags only. No rgba (print fails). Shadows ring or whisper.
7. Whitespace is design. Don't fear xl/2xl gaps.
8. No synthetic bold. Hanja only as small parenthetical, never large display.

Fonts (all free OFL, Korean):
- Nanum Myeongjo (display 800, headings 700)
- Gowun Batang (body, quote, numbers)
- Gowun Dodum (labels, meta, mono labels)
- Pretendard (UI sans, optional)
- Noto Serif KR, Noto Sans KR, Hahmlet, IBM Plex Sans KR (alternates)
- Cormorant Garamond italic (Latin emphasis)
- JetBrains Mono (code, tables)

Commands:
- npx satgat help
- npm run dev
- npm run lint
- npm test
- npm run build
- npm run tokens:check
- npm run verify:templates
- npm run verify:web   # against a running production server
- npm run specimens:render
